data.title: 祀 · 雾气清泉水下龙尾缠绕
data.action: 倚靠泉池石壁水下龙尾轻缠
data.lighting: 温泉水面折射的月光与竹灯暖晕
data.description: 基地后山隐秘的温泉池中水汽氤氲，祀浑身湿透、仅裹着一袭几乎被温水浸透贴肉的薄浴巾。她背靠光滑的青石池壁，晶莹的水珠顺着天鹅颈与锁骨滑入深邃沟壑，眼眸迷蒙泛水光，修长的青色龙尾在水下游动、悄然缠上你的脚踝——「水温……好像越来越烫了……」
data.promptProse: Submerged to her chest in the steamy hot spring with a damp clinging white towel, Si rests against the smooth rock wall with flushed cheeks and glistening eyes, her tail curling through the rippling water toward the viewer.
data.animaCaption: She leans against the steaming rock pool in her wet clinging wrap as ripples catch the lantern light around her tail.
